mock_resolution_plan: This epic introduces no temporary mocks. All assertion fills and test infrastructure operate against the live browser state via window.__notestrTest* hooks. No mock-registry entries are created.

seams.data: Test hook interface: group epoch, members, and pubkey leaf count exposed from MarmotProvider to e2e layer

invariants: All three hooks are installed only inside the isTestRuntime() gate in client.tsx
__notestrTestGroupEpoch returns Number(g.state.groupContext.epoch) or null if group absent
__notestrTestGroupMembers returns sorted hex pubkeys via getGroupMembers or null if absent
__notestrTestPubkeyLeafCount returns getPubkeyLeafNodes(g.state, pubkeyHex).length, 0 for unknown pubkeys
None of the three hooks mutate state

seams.data: waitForDuration fixture method: collect relay events for a fixed duration without rejecting

invariants: Never rejects on timeout; always resolves with the array of events received
Collects events for exactly ms milliseconds using setTimeout

stories.name: assert-s5-biconditional-partial
stories.title: assertS5 biconditional (partial, model-flag-based), scoped to current group
stories.description: Replace the positive-only assertS5 body with a full biconditional using m.memberA/m.memberB as truth and leafIndexesFor(...).length as the observable side, scoped to m.groupIdA. Both directions (member → leafCount >= 1; non-member → leafCount === 0) are enforced. Includes the early-return guard for null groupIdA / pubkeys.
stories.notes: S5 will later replace this body with the hook-based full biconditional (AC-S5-5). S1's model-flag-based form is the stable intermediate state until S4's hooks land. No new imports needed; leafIndexesFor already exists in the file.

stories.name: assert-s7-last-switched-fill
stories.title: assertS7 fill via lastSwitched model field
stories.description: Extend ModelState with a lastSwitched field (initialised to null in constructor AND reset in model.reset()), populate it in SwCommand.run immediately before the switch, and implement assertS7 to read post-switch __notestrTestTasks and assert no task carries a groupId in lastSwitched.priorGroupIds. Remove the stale comment claiming the check lives in SwCommand.run.
stories.notes: Architecture constraint (implementation note 6): SwCommand.run MUST capture priorGroupIds BEFORE the switch, not after. The lastSwitched field must be reset in BOTH the constructor and model.reset() per AC-S7-1 amendment.

stories.name: a14-ndk-subscriber-wiring
stories.title: A14 wiring in LgCommand and FdCommand via openNdkSubscriber
stories.description: Replace the dead tasksBefore/tasksAfter capture-and-discard in LgCommand.run and FdCommand.run (last-leaf branch) with a real subscriber assertion using openNdkSubscriber. Add getNostrGroupIdHex helper to two-party.ts. Add waitForDuration(filter, ms) to ndk-subscriber.ts — a never-reject variant of waitForEvents. Wire the existing dead import, making it live.
stories.notes: waitForDuration is a NEW method on NdkSubscriber — do NOT modify waitForEvents. The A14 assertion is wire-level (AC-A14-8): zero kind-445 events on the subscriber's connection in 2 seconds. FdCommand.run only applies in the leafCount === 1 (last-leaf) branch. ~65 LOC estimated.

stories.name: test-hooks-epoch-members-leafcount
stories.title: Add three test hooks: __notestrTestGroupEpoch, __notestrTestGroupMembers, __notestrTestPubkeyLeafCount
stories.description: Declare the three new optional Window properties in src/types/notestr-test-hooks.d.ts. Install all three hooks in the single useEffect in src/marmot/client.tsx alongside the existing __notestrTestPubkeyLeafIndexes. Add getGroupMembersHook, getGroupEpochHook, and getPubkeyLeafCountHook wrappers to e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts. No assertion changes; pure infrastructure.
stories.notes: Critical import landmine: getGroupMembers and getPubkeyLeafNodes are NOT yet imported in client.tsx (only getPubkeyLeafNodeIndexes is). Both must be added to the @internet-privacy/marmot-ts import block at client.tsx:13-20 or tsc will fail. The epoch hook coerces bigint to number via Number(g.state.groupContext.epoch) — precision loss accepted per AC-HOOK-3. Two notestr-test-hooks.d.ts files exist (src/types/ and src/marmot/); only src/types/ is the target.
